summary: This study tested ear seed pressure combined with the medicine atorvastatin in people with high blood fat levels and a condition called Phlegm-Dampness syndrome. The research looked at changes in blood fat levels and traditional health symptoms over an eight-week period. University of Medicine and Pharmacy at Ho Chi Minh City sponsored the trial, which has been completed. A total of 80 participants took part in the study.

facts.sponsor: University of Medicine and Pharmacy at Ho Chi Minh City
